name: Automatic Site Icon Picker
description: provides an automatic site-icon (favicon) picker/formatter for link fields.
project_description:
This module provides a simple integration with the Vemetric Favicon API . It retrieves and downloads a website’s favicon automatically, based on a provided URL.

 Send request and download image if exists (if url is right).

 

 

 Advantages: 
 

 Easy to use

 
 Small size

 
 If image was downloaded already, it will not send request once more

 
 Draws only icon, text and icon, link and icon
